headline: Pacific Lime and Cement Secures $50 Million to Fund PNG Operations
summary: Pacific Lime and Cement concluded a $50 million funding round alongside planned US financing to prepare for its first commercial lime production in Papua New Guinea.
why: Lime is an essential chemical input for major copper and gold mining operations; local production reduces mineral processing import costs in Papua New Guinea.

impacts.name: Pacific Lime and Cement
impacts.why: The $50 million capital raise provides funding to initiate lime manufacturing in PNG.
